description: The agent credential file (agent-credentials.md). paths: resolve the file for platform (process.platform names; anything but win32 and darwin follows the XDG rules), home and env; compare with backslashes replaced by slashes; null means there is no file. issuers: normalise a base URL into its key. reads: given the file (file is the parsed JSON, fileText its raw text; neither means no file) and the clock at now, report which slots for issuer are live and whether each live slot has a usable cached access token. writes: apply op (set a slot to exactly op.slot, or remove one) for issuer to the file before (null: no file) at now; expected is the JSON written (compare structurally), null when the file is deleted, or "unchanged" when nothing may be written.

paths.name: linux XDG_CONFIG_HOME with a trailing slash
no home but an absolute XDG_CONFIG_HOME
windows with neither APPDATA nor a home

reads.name: both slots live, claimed token cached
the issuer given with a trailing slash and capitals
assertion_expires as a date without a time
assertion_expires with an offset and no fraction
lowercase t and z are not accepted
offset that puts the expiry in the past
cached token without the whcc_ prefix

writes.name: set claimed next to a sandbox
remove one slot keeps the other
removing the last slot deletes the file
removing a missing slot when nothing else is left deletes the file
expired slots of every issuer are dropped, and issuers left empty
unknown keys at the top and in issuers are kept
issuer values that are not objects are dropped
a newer version is left alone
a file without a version is replaced
setting an expired slot leaves nothing to write
